title: Future Quest #5 7 8 9 Lot DC 2016-2017 Hanna-Barbera Space Ghost Jonny Quest
condition_description: All bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Lot of 4: Future Quest #5 (December 2016), #7 (January 2017), #8 (February 2017) and #9 (March 2017), DC Comics - the Hanna-Barbera action-hero crossover with Jonny Quest, Space Ghost, the Herculoids, Birdman, Mightor, the Impossibles and more. Written by Jeff Parker; art by Evan "Doc" Shaner, Craig Rousseau, Ariel Olivetti, Ron Randall and others. Direct sales, $3.99 cover price each.

Back covers: #5 Snickers (Batman/Superman/Wonder Woman) ad; #7 and #8 Suicide Squad Extended Cut ads; #9 Powerless (NBC) ad.

Condition: all bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
